Apple's September event is approaching, with the date likely to be announced next week. Here are over ten new Apple products coming soon, most of which are expected to be unveiled at the September event.

Here are all the new Apple products that may launch at the September event or shortly after.

Apple's September event is always the company's biggest product launch of the year. Although there are always a few surprises, new iPhone and Apple Watch models are almost certain to debut in September.

Here's what we expect this year:

In addition to these expected products, another one with a high chance of launching is a new AirPods with an infrared camera, which may be named AirPods Pro 4.

Apple often launches new AirPods at its September event because they are marketed as iPhone accessories. This week, a video leaked from macOS 26.7 gave us our first look at this long-rumoured product.

In addition, four brand new Apple home products are reportedly launching as early as next month:

The above ten products are the most likely items to be announced in September. Other possibilities include an iPad mini with an OLED display, a home security camera, and perhaps even a new Mac — though the latter is more likely to be saved for October.

Which upcoming Apple product are you most excited about? Let us know in the comments section.
